map.推荐时间为经验范围，实际需结合设备与工艺微调: The recommended times are empirical ranges and need fine-tuning in practice with the equipment and process
map.深色通常需更长蒸化时间以保证固色充分: Dark shades usually need longer steaming time to ensure adequate fixation
map.蒸化工艺参数设定：按染料与色泽深浅取推荐时间中值作为初始工艺点。: Steaming process parameter setting: take the midpoint of the recommended time by dye and shade depth as the initial process point.
map.新配方蒸化时间估算：换染料或深浅变化时快速查推荐区间，减少试错。: New formula steaming time estimation: quickly look up the recommended range when changing the dye or the shade, reducing trial and error.
map.蒸化工序质量排查：固色不足时核对是否时间偏短或染料不匹配。: Steaming step quality troubleshooting: when fixation is insufficient, check whether the time was too short or the dye does not match.
map.活性深色蒸化时间示例: Example steaming time for a dark reactive shade
map.棉织物活性染料深色，推荐蒸化 8~12 min（中值 10 min）、102~1: For a dark reactive dye on cotton, the recommended steaming is 8~12 min (midpoint 10 min) at 102~104℃ saturated steam; if measured fixation is too pale, first confirm whether the steam is saturated and the humidity meets spec rather than simply extending the time.
map.主要受染料类别、纤维、色泽深浅与蒸汽条件影响；深色比浅色需更久，分散/酸性常需较: Mainly the dye class, fibre, shade depth and steam conditions; dark shades need longer than light ones, and disperse/acid dyes often need high-temperature dry steaming rather than saturated steam.
map.深浅色时间差多少？: How much longer for dark than light shades?
map.同染料下深色通常比浅色长 2~5 min，具体以推荐区间为准，过久可能导致渗化或: With the same dye, dark shades are typically 2~5 min longer than light ones; the recommended range governs, and excessive time can cause bleeding or a poorer hand feel.
map.染料与纤维不匹配会怎样？: What happens if the dye and fibre do not match?
map.如涤纶用了需还原蒸化的染料而条件不符固色失败；工具会识别纤维/染料不匹配并提示核: For example using a dye on polyester that needs vat steaming fails to fix when the conditions do not match; the tool identifies fibre/dye mismatches and prompts you to check the process system.
map.蒸化时间直接影响染料固色效果。本工具根据织物类型、染料类型与色泽深浅，给出饱和蒸: Steaming time directly affects dye fixation. Based on fabric type, dye type and shade depth, this tool gives the recommended time range and midpoint for saturated steam steaming, helping determine steaming step parameters quickly.
map.覆盖活性、还原、硫化、直接、分散、酸性六大染料: Covers six dye classes: reactive, vat, sulphur, direct, disperse and acid
map.按浅/中/深色调整时间范围: Adjusts the time range for light/medium/dark shades
